key_insights: Bitcoin is stuck in a monthly range between $35-37k (support) and $58k (resistance) with the critical midpoint at $43-47k
The $43-47k level has been tested 3-4 times already, making each subsequent test weaker and more likely to break
Range breakouts tend to be violent events due to accumulated open interest and forced liquidations
Best strategy is to wait for the level to break before entering, rather than betting on which direction it will break
A failed breakout from $43-47k would provide an excellent short entry with clear invalidation at the breakout high
If the range breaks to the downside, the next significant support levels are between $14-20k
summary: Cred analyzes Bitcoin's consolidation within a monthly range of $35-37k to $58k, focusing on the critical $43-47k midpoint that has been tested multiple times. He recommends waiting for either a successful breakout targeting the $50s or a failed breakout that would provide a clear short opportunity. The current downtrend structure remains bearish with lower lows and highs, but a break of the midpoint could signal the first significant structural shift.
